summary: Frontend-only testing of the new public /handeln Investment Knowledge Hub (HandelnHub.jsx) plus route regressions. Verified public access (no auth redirect), hero, 7 sticky sub-nav + 7 hero-jump anchors, 4 asset-class cross-links, 5 order types, 5 cost cards, 6 risk points, 6 mistake cards, Boersen-ABC (58 terms, live search, A-Z filter, accordion, empty state, reset), 3 bottom CTAs, mobile 390x844 responsiveness, and regressions for /dashboard/handeln (auth-protected trading page), /themen/*, /fonds-grundlagen, /wissen, /news, /. Result: all functional acceptance criteria pass; only minor/cosmetic observations.

integration_issues.issue: Page loads and the market table renders (482 von 482 Aktien) but a red banner 'Einige Dashboard-Daten konnten nicht geladen werden' is shown on load - some dashboard aggregate call fails. Pre-existing, unrelated to the new hub, but should be checked.

issues: Global sticky info card 'Aktien im Fokus' (bottom right) covers ~40% of the mobile viewport height and stays while scrolling, obscuring ABC accordion content and bottom CTAs until dismissed. Consider a compact/collapsed variant below sm breakpoint.
Sticky sub-nav has no active-section highlighting (no scroll-spy), so on a very long page the user gets no orientation feedback. Cosmetic/nice-to-have.

action_items: Optional: investigate the '/dashboard/handeln' dashboard-data error banner (pre-existing).
Optional: make the global 'Aktien im Fokus' info card compact on mobile so it does not cover 40% of the /handeln viewport.

Note for spec alignment: searching 'ETF' returns 3 hits (ETF, Index, Xetra) and 'Dividende' returns 5 hits because the search also matches the long definition text. This is reasonable behaviour but differs from the expected '1 hit for ETF' in the test request - decide whether to weight/limit matching to term+short.
critical_code_review_comments: HandelnHub.jsx is ~750 lines with all content constants inline; consider moving ASSET_CLASSES/ORDER_TYPES/COSTS/RISK_POINTS/COMMON_MISTAKES into /data like boersenAbc.js to keep the page component under ~300 lines.

The auto-open effect `useEffect(..., [query, filteredTerms])` recomputes openTerms on every filteredTerms identity change; with activeLetter changes while a query is active this re-expands all matches. Works, but gating on query only (and computing matches inside) would avoid redundant state writes.
scrollToId uses a hard-coded 96px offset for the sticky sub-nav; on mobile the sub-nav height differs slightly - consider measuring the nav element height instead.
test_credentials: admin@kapitalmitte.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - login works, redirects to /admin
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: The visitor welcome gate (data-testid=visitor-welcome-gate) is a full-screen modal with z-[10000] that blocks ALL clicks and whose 'Akzeptieren' button stays disabled until a role is picked. The localStorage keys are NOT 'visitor_welcome_dismissed'/'cookie_consent' - use kapitalmitte_visitor_profile = {"residence":"DE","role":"private","isUsPerson":false} and kapitalmitte_cookie_consent = {"necessary":true,"analytics":true,"marketing":true}, then reload. Also note: smooth-scroll to the last section (#fehler) needs >2s wait before asserting getBoundingClientRect().top; with 900ms the assertion falsely fails. Verified data: abc-result-count=58, letter A=4 terms, disabled letters = J, Q, U. Screenshots in /app/test_reports/ui_it13b|c|d|e.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Two earlier apparent failures were test-environment artifacts: (1) blocked clicks caused by the visitor welcome gate (wrong localStorage bypass keys documented in the request), (2) 'fehler' anchor scroll failing due to smooth-scroll duration exceeding the 900ms wait - both resolved with correct bypass keys and longer waits.
